items.title: Manuel Mello Interview, 1959-08-03
items.q: Leonce and I played the last job with that horn. We played at a reception.

ctx.x: And, uh, Henry? Henry was two years younger than I was.
Are the other two still living? Henry and Sam? No. Sam is living, but Henry and Leonce are both dead. Henry died about two years after Leonce.
Well, to get into Leonce's life a little, did he study music?
